# external

* [Conferencing and Recording Apps](/external/conferencing-apps.md) - The external applications (Meet, Teams, Zoom, OBS) that receive the virtual camera image.
* [GNOME Desktop (Wayland)](/external/gnome-desktop-environment.md) - The external GNOME/Wayland desktop the app integrates with for tray, menu, shortcut and notifications.
* [libturbojpeg](/external/libturbojpeg.md) - libjpeg-turbo's TurboJPEG API, used to decode MJPEG frames straight to Y/Cb/Cr planes; installed as the libturbojpeg0 package.
* [Polycom EagleEye IV USB Camera](/external/polycom-eagleeye-iv.md) - The motorised UVC 1.10 camera hardware the project drives; exposes an MJPEG stream and V4L2 PTZ/zoom/focus/image controls.
* [RTMO-s Pose Model](/external/rtmo-pose-model.md) - The external pose-estimation model that supplies all person detections and keypoints.
* [v4l2loopback](/external/v4l2loopback.md) - The kernel module that provides the /dev/video10 loopback camera the app writes framed video to.
